title: Chemical Reactions: Predicting, Balancing, and Net Ionic Equations
author: Dr. Dan
description: Interactive chemistry practice game with 116 reaction examples. Students balance equations, predict products using reaction recipes and charge balancing, assign phases of matter, write complete ionic equations, and cancel spectator ions to form net ionic equations. Includes 49 guided net ionic examples, solubility rules adapted from the course green sheet, gas evolution and neutralization references, formatted chemical equation entry, hints, answer checking, celebrations, and embedded lessons from Dr. Dan's Chapter 10 playlist.
